physical_skill: Mount an SO-101 arm to a table edge as its build guide directs: for each of the base's two wings, hook a trigger clamp's fixed jaw blind under the tabletop, slide the movable jaw down onto the wing, and pump the trigger until both pads bear (no gap over 0.5 mm) with the bar square to the table, keeping the base on its marks; then let go with both grippers clear.
valid_shortcuts: Either clamp may go on either wing, and two clamps on one wing count as one wing secured (0.5). Fitting only one clamp scores 0.5. Too few trigger strokes (jaws not bearing), pads half off the wings, clamping bare tabletop beside the base, or never letting go all score 0 (red-teamed). Pushing the base more than 4 mm off its marks or tipping it off the tabletop scores 0. There is no way to secure the base other than clamping its wings.
